about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Front-End Developer with 8+ years of experience (since 2017), building web and mobile applications that are responsive and easy to use. I work with React, Ionic, Angular, AngularJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, HTML5, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, and Cordova to create modular components, integrate APIs, and deliver smooth user experiences.
I enjoy working in Agile teams, writing clean and maintainable code, and building applications that are functional, efficient, and easy to scale or update.

experiences.title: Programmer Analyst
achievements: Assigned as the sole UI developer for an internal mobile application built with Ionic Cordova 3, responsible for production support, client requested enhancements, and UI solution design in close collaboration with stakeholders and backend teams.

Simultaneously contributed to a large-scale public-facing application in Hong Kong (serving thousands of daily users) using Ionic 5 as part of a front-end team. Key contributions included Okta authentication integration (POC to full implementation), production issue fixes, vulnerability remediation, and customization and maintenance of Cordova plugins to meet Android and iOS store compliance.

Currently part of a new initiative to consolidate multiple Sun Life sub-websites into a single unified platform built with React, focusing on scalable UI architecture, shared components, and consistent user experience across regions.

experiences.title: UI Developer
achievements: Immediately assigned to Sunlife Global Solutions upon start where I contributed as a front-end developer for three years before being signed directly by Sunlife Global Solutions.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
achievements: Developed and maintained the majority of the company’s in-house mobile and web applications, supporting daily business operations across multiple teams.
Built and enhanced Mostyle POS, an internal point-of-sale system used by in-house businesses, covering both frontend and backend functionality.

Worked as a full stack developer, using Ionic for mobile and web interfaces, PHP for backend services, and managing deployments and updates across Android (Android Studio) and iOS (Xcode) environments.
Gained hands-on experience delivering end-to-end features, from UI implementation to backend integration, while supporting production systems.
